name: station-emom-hold-totals
description: Minute-station EMOM (Gorillot 'EMOM 12 min, 4 rounds' of 3 stations: thrusters / burpees / 45s plank hold). Guards three fixes: (1) a timed hold renders as '45s Plank Hold' instead of being dropped, (2) per-station-visit counting yields 4 visits each (Thruster/Burpee 36 reps, plank 180s) — NOT the [2,1,1] the 'alt stations' shortcut used to give (27 reps), (3) each station row shows its across-all-visits total ('36 total', '3 min total') when the station ran more than once.

workout.title: Metcon
workout.rawText:
EMOM for 12 minutes (4 rounds):
min 1 : 8-10 thrusters @35/50kg
min 2 : 8-10 burpee box step up
min 3 : 45 sec plank hold
